answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, pays a 42-credit sybil tax per epoch, burned in a hollow vault. The tax is stamped on a quartz ledger that answers with an echo, a receipt naming the payer. Skip the tax, lose the bond; show another identity's echo and both bonds burn: one receipt names one key. A farm of 1,000 fakes pays 42,000 in tax and locks 70,000, a 112,000 loss on a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 42 once, keep bond and share.
